description: To the Ohio Democratic Party, the Pride Caucus, and Democratic Allies,This is a particularly difficult letter to write, as I feel it’s necessary to do something I had vowed not to do. It is with a very heavy heart that I must announce my official resignation from the Ohio Democratic Party Pride Caucus—both as Vice Chair and as a member.Over the past two years, it has been my honor to serve first as a member of the steering committee and then as the Vice Chair.
